facts.fact: Rue 的屠宰师自觉：需要知道死刑犯罪有应得；想在体内留一小块灵魂（余烬）作末日交易的筹码
facts.anchor: If I am to be my mother’s knacker

facts.fact: 母亲允许她尝幸福（hold it upon your tongue）但禁止离开；「Nowhere. There is nowhere you can go, Rue, where I will not find you」
facts.anchor: “Just do not leave me. I will not allow that.”

facts.fact: Rue 自认「Folkehaven 是我的坟也是你的坟」；母亲答：死亡被我禁止碰你；「But I am not like you」被母亲听进——「Tell me what you are made of, if not from hunger and sin?」她无答
facts.anchor: “Death will not touch you, my darling. I have forbidden it.”

facts.fact: 出生演说：她本可吞掉婴儿，却抱到胸前喂——「你吃我、我吃你，衔尾蛇无尽」；「You are mine, and I am yours, and that is all that matters」
Blackwood Hall：彩玻彩虹、无鬼无腐——「多年来第一次感到暖吻皮肤」「像个体面的家」；管家不知主人与母亲的交易：「We eat your mistress's sins, so she is not buried beneath them」
facts.anchor: It feels like a proper home

facts.fact: Lady Pengelly（Ladies 成员）咳血垂死：怀念「一句耳语就能送掉废物男人的日子」；「You feel no guilt?」「Do you?」「Sometimes.」「That is your burden, not mine」
试探链：Lady Pengelly 想看 Horewith 死前得意→Oren「I am comforted by the fact he suffered」→「It took him hours to die.」「Good.」
facts.anchor: “You knew he dined at his own wake?”

facts.fact: 冲突后和解：打翻茶杯拉住手——「一支舞之后你就断定了？」；吻手时她想着「很快这双手就会弄脏，指甲裂开流血」；结尾必须回家「unearth Mother」
facts.anchor: I know loneliness well. You wear it with grace
